narrative_engine.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack tangled · EMA spread -5.02 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 5.553-5.652 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip), where the footprint printed its confirmation. Risk is defined beyond 5.764; the first objective pays 1.35R at 5.596.

plan.triggerRule: footprint abs fired sell in short direction at the zone
plan.invalidation: structure beyond 5.764 (signal zone / ±2σ VWAP / 0.5 ATR buffer)
vetoes: M1 A/A+ demoted: 3-TF alignment incomplete AND no absorption/CVD-divergence at the zone (3-TF: H4 13×89 trend · H1 structure against · m15 bar lost EMA89)

athena_oracle.verdict: Constructive bullish lean 65/100 — trend aligned, flow confirming, squeeze fuel overhead
